title: orthilia elatior
intro: Orthilia elatior, commonly known as tall mountain cranberry, is a perennial flowering plant belonging to the heath family (Ericaceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Orthilia elatior include acting as an antimicrobial and antifungal agent, as well as exhibiting immunomodulatory effects, suggesting its potential use in treating various infections and immune-related disorders. The bioactive constituents of Orthilia elatior include phenolic compounds, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
